newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oil unlikely to see increased demand.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oil unlikely to see increased demand.

text.p: European vegetable oil traders do not expect any increase in demand over the Easter period.
"We have two holiday shortened weeks coming up and the way things are going I don't think there will be any increase in demand," said one.
They said trading is likely to remain hand-to-mouth while the North American markets remain volatile.
"We don't follow Chicago very closely, but buyers are always put off when the funds are in control of that market," said another trader.
Traders said there maybe some short covering towards the end of the week, but beyond that they expect the market to remain quiet.
Palm oil prices seem likely to consolidate both in Malaysia and Europe with Malaysian export figures watched very carefully.
Rising production and low demand continue to weigh palm oil, but a rebound is possible after the Easter Holiday.
"You can't keep a good market down," joked one trader.
Coconut oil is likely to remain quiet owing to the Easter break but there us some evidence of a softening in nearby prices while forwards are holding firm.
